company.shortDescription: Kema is a fintech platform enabling invoicing, payment collection, and improved cash flow management for businesses.
company.description: Kema is a fintech platform that helps businesses streamline invoicing, automate payment collection, and improve cash flow. It offers tools for managing accounts receivable, tracking payments, and accessing invoice financing. By digitizing financial operations, Kema enables faster transactions, reduces manual work, and supports better financial planning and business growth.
